description: Node-based sequencer of sixteen nodes joined by arrows printed on the panel, each node carrying up to four CV sliders, with a different arrangement of arrows, sliders and modifiers each week

params.text: Sets the CV that step of the node plays, giving the voltage of the low -/+ knob at the bottom of its travel and the high knob at the top; a node takes four clock pulses, shared between its sliders
Turns this configuration's global modifier on and off, the same switch that playing the node carrying that modifier flips
Triggers a reset every so many node transitions, 1 to 64; at the top of its travel no internal reset happens, which the panel marks OFF and the tooltip prints as Infinty
Sets which column a reset jumps to: Col 1, Col 2, Col 3 or Col 4 by number, or Current Col, Next Col, Previous Col or Random Col
Sets which of this configuration's arrows are active: No Arrows, Left Arrows or All Arrows
Sets the voltage the bottom of every slider's travel gives, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage the top of every slider's travel gives, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the sequencer on one step, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge resets the sequencer to the column the COL knob names, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge plays that node, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V; patch it from another node's output or from an external gate

outputs.text: Carries 10V while a node is playing, and one channel per node playing at once, up to four, when the configuration runs more than one at a time
Carries the CV of the step being played, scaled between the two -/+ knobs and passed through the built-in quantizer, with one channel per node playing at once, up to four
Carries 10V when that node finishes and the branch through this jack is the one taken; patch it to the input of another node to add a connection of your own

notes: The arrangement of arrows, sliders and modifiers is a configuration, and a new one is published weekly. A module keeps the one it was made with until This Week's Config is used on its menu.
What a modifier icon does is written in its own tooltip, so turn tooltips on in Rack's settings and hover the icon to read it.
A node reached with no active arrow and no patch cable out of it triggers a reset.
Bypassing this module leaves every output at 0V.
menu: Quantizer — a submenu setting the scale and root note the CV output is quantized to
Randomize CVs — rolls a new value for every slider on every node
This Week's Config — replaces this module's configuration with the one published for the current week
Open Config Collection — opens a browser of every configuration this rack has used, where one can be chosen, marked a favourite or filtered by the modifiers it carries
Random Config from Collection — switches to a configuration picked at random from that collection
Slider Light Settings — a submenu holding the two settings that change how a slider's lit part is drawn
Bidirectional — on the Slider Light Settings submenu; lights a slider from the middle of its track out to the handle rather than from the bottom up
Full On — on the Slider Light Settings submenu; lights the whole of a slider's track rather than only the part below the handle
